**Pizzeria La Strada in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria La Strada** in the heart of **Tirol**—where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a crispy **Focaccia**, our handmade pizzas are baked fresh in a traditional wood-fired oven. Pair your meal with a glass of fine Italian wine or a refreshing **Aperol Spritz**, and let the cozy atmosphere transport you straight to the streets of **Naples**.

After dinner, take a short stroll through **Innsbruck**’s picturesque old town, where medieval towers and lively squares invite you to explore. Or, if you’re visiting in winter, enjoy a warm **Kaiserschmarrn** with a cup of **Glühwein** before hitting the slopes of **Nordkette** or **Axamer Lizum**.

At **Pizzeria La Strada**, we believe in simple, high-quality ingredients—just like Nonna used to make. Come taste the difference!
